question: A shell fired from a gun explodes in mid-air into several fragments. Ignoring air resistance, the centre of mass of the fragments

options.text: moves along a straight line from the point of explosion
continues along the original parabolic path
falls vertically from the point of explosion
comes to rest at the point of explosion

solution: The explosion forces are internal, so they cannot change the motion of the centre of mass. The only external force is still gravity, so the centre of mass keeps following the same parabola (until a fragment hits the ground).
